raknetify.console.fields: Habayntu waa inay ka koobnaataa goobahan oo keliya: %1$s
raknetify.console.host_string: Qiimaha goobta host waa inuu noqdaa qoraal JSON ah.
raknetify.console.duplicate_destination: Meesha loo wareejinayo xiriirka ayaa laba jeer ku jirta liiska: %1$s
raknetify.console.port_range: %1$s waa inuu noqdaa tiro dhan oo u dhexaysa 1 iyo 65535.

raknetify.console.invalid_host: Magaca martigeliyaha loo wareejinayo xiriirka ayaa khaldan: %1$s
raknetify.console.voice_enabled: Goobta enabled oo keliya ayaa la oggol yahay. Qiimaheedu waa inuu ahaadaa true ama false.
raknetify.console.voice_conflict: Barnaamij kale oo wada sheekaysiga codka ah ayaa horay u isticmaalaya soketka UDP.
raknetify.console.no_tcp: Lama helin soket Minecraft ah oo sugaya xiriirrada TCP.
raknetify.console.diagnostics_denied: Xiriirka %1$s waa la jaray, waayo wuxuu marar badan codsaday tirakoob uu seerfarku diiday inuu bixiyo.
raknetify.console.inflated_limit: Cabbirka jirka xogta RakNet ayaa ka weyn %1$s B ka dib markii la kala bixiyey.
raknetify.console.frame_limit: Cabbirka jirka xogta Minecraft ayaa ka weyn %1$s B.
raknetify.console.invalid_channel: Kanaalka kala hormarinta xogta la cadaadiyey ee RakNet ayaa khaldan.
raknetify.console.ordered_peer: Raknetify2 iyo %1$s waxay ku heshiiyeen habka ordered.
raknetify.console.ordered_required: Seerfarku wuxuu u baahan yahay habka ordered. Cusboonaysii Raknetify2 ee macmiilka ama ku xirmo TCP adigoo raknet; ka saaraya bilowga cinwaanka.
raknetify.console.incompatible: Labada dhinac kuma heshiin karaan hab Raknetify2 oo ay wada isticmaali karaan.
raknetify.console.ordered_mode: Raknetify2 wuxuu adeegsanayaa habka ordered. Macmiilka waa in la cusboonaysiiyo, xaqiijinta helitaankuna waa inay ka timaaddaa dhinaca wax helay.
raknetify.console.multichannel_mode: Raknetify2 wuxuu isticmaalayaa habka kanaallada badan.
raknetify.console.stopping: Waxaa la joojinayaa seerfarka RakNet ee %1$s.
raknetify.console.bind_error: Soketka qaabila xogta UDP ee RakNet laguma xiri karin cinwaanka maxalliga ah: %1$s
raknetify.console.listener_update: Markii isdhexgalka shabakaddu is beddelay, lama cusboonaysiin karin soketyada qaabila UDP ee RakNet.
raknetify.console.interface_update: Lama cusboonaysiin karin cinwaannada isdhexgallada shabakadda ee qalabkan.
raknetify.console.start_error: Lama bilaabi karin soketka qaabila UDP ee RakNet.
raknetify.console.spigot_listening: RakNet wuxuu xogta UDP ku sugayaa dekedda %1$s ee cinwaanka %2$s.
raknetify.console.stop_interrupted: Hawsha joojinta soketka RakNet ayaa hakad gashay intaanay dhammaan.
raknetify.console.velocity_version: Raknetify2 lama jaanqaadi karo noocan Velocity.
raknetify.console.login: %1$s wuxuu ku soo galay RakNet. MTU waa %2$s.
raknetify.console.no_login_channel: Laguma heshiin karo habka ordered haddii uusan jirin kanaalka gelitaanku.
raknetify.console.leak_invalid: Qiimaha %1$s kuma habboona io.netty.leakDetection.level. Waxaa la adeegsanayaa SIMPLE.
raknetify.console.decrypt: Sirta xiriirka waa la furi waayey. Xiriirka RakNet wuu xumaaday.
raknetify.console.voice_closed: Soketka wada sheekaysiga codku wuu xiran yahay.
raknetify.console.voice_missing: Ma jiro soket RakNet ah oo ku sugaya cinwaanka %2$s iyo dekedda UDP %1$s ee wada sheekaysiga codka.
raknetify.console.voice_multiple: In ka badan hal soket oo RakNet ah ayaa xogta ku sugaya cinwaanka %2$s iyo dekedda UDP %1$s ee wada sheekaysiga codka.
raknetify.console.voice_port: Dekedda wada sheekaysiga codku waa inay la mid noqotaa deked si cad loogu dejiyey RakNet.
raknetify.console.voice_dest: Cinwaanka UDP ee codka loo dirayo waa in mar hore loo helay cinwaankiisa IP.
raknetify.console.voice_timeout: Waqtiga loo qabtay dirista xirmada UDP ee codku wuu dhammaaday.
raknetify.console.voice_write: Xirmada UDP ee codka lama diri karo: %1$s
raknetify.console.listener_missing: %1$s uma diyaarsana soketka qaabila xiriirrada BungeeCord ee %2$s.
raknetify.console.compression_sync: Lama waafajin karin cadaadinta xogta iyo tan Velocity.
raknetify.console.mapping_missing: Jadwalka kanaallada hab-maamuuska %1$s ayaa maqan. Xiriirku wuxuu qaadan karaa waqti dheer si uu uga jawaabo.
raknetify.console.via_channel: ViaVersion lagama hawlgelin karin kanaalka RakNet %1$s: %2$s
raknetify.console.wrapper: Raknetify2 wuxuu ka bilaabmayaa deegaanka goonida ah ee kordhinta Velocity.
raknetify.console.wrapper_failed: Raknetify2 kama bilaabmin deegaanka goonida ah. Waxaa hadda laga bilaabayaa deegaanka caadiga ah ee Velocity.
raknetify.console.missing_server: Ka dib beddelkii seerfarka, %1$s kuma xirna wax seerfar ah.
raknetify.console.missing_connection: Xiriirkii aasaasiga ahaa ee seerfarka %1$s ma jiro.
raknetify.console.handler_unknown: Qaybtan Netty ee maamusha xogta lama aqoonsan: %1$s
raknetify.console.spigot_version: Noocan Raknetify2 ee Spigot wuxuu u baahan yahay Minecraft 26.3.
raknetify.console.acceptor_missing: Soketka TCP ee Minecraft lagama helin qayb Netty oo la taageero oo qaabili karta xiriirrada.
raknetify.console.spigot_mappings: Jadwalka jiheynta xirmooyinka Minecraft 26.3 ayaa maqan.
raknetify.console.streaming_compression: RakNet ayaa cadaadiya xogta inta ay socoto, sidaa darteed cadaadinta caadiga ah ee Minecraft waa la joojiyey.
raknetify.console.krypton: Waa la helay Krypton. Habka uu Raknetify2 kula shaqeeyo Krypton wuu shaqaynayaa.
raknetify.console.multichannel_unavailab: Raknetify2 ma bilaabi karo habka kanaallada badan, waayo habkaas lama heli karo.
raknetify.console.packet_missing: Fasalka xirmada ee loo baahan yahay si xogta loogu jiheeyo kanaallo badan lama dejin.
raknetify.console.leak_level: Raknetify2 wuxuu adeegsanayaa heerka %1$s si uu u ogaado xusuusta lunta.
raknetify.console.proxy_required: RakNet wuxuu u baahan yahay madaxa PROXY oo la xaqiijiyey. Ku deji %1$s faylka %2$s.
raknetify.console.voice_service: Simple Voice Chat ma diiwaangelin adeeggiisa Bukkit ee %1$s.
